answer.text: Some people say that breakfast is the most important meal of the day. On the one hand, a school survey found that students who eat breakfast concentrate better in class. They also have more energy in the morning. On the other hand, the evidence is limited, because most studies only ask people about their habits. Although breakfast helps many students, some people are just not hungry in the morning. I conclude that the claim is partly true, but it depends on the person. It is unlikely that breakfast is equally important for everyone.
accepted: Some people say that breakfast is the most important meal of the day. On the one hand, a school survey found that students who eat breakfast concentrate better in class. They also have more energy in the morning. On the other hand, the evidence is limited, because most studies only ask people about their habits. Although breakfast helps many students, some people are just not hungry in the morning. I conclude that the claim is partly true, but it depends on the person. It is unlikely that breakfast is equally important for everyone.

Some people think that we should do homework every night. On the one hand, a study found that regular practice improves grades. It also helps students learn to organise their time. On the other hand, the evidence is limited, because tired students learn less. Although homework can help, too much of it may hurt sleep. In conclusion, the claim is partly true, but it depends on the student. It is unlikely that the same amount of homework is good for everyone.

feedback.es: Una valoración equilibrada atribuye la afirmación, da razones a favor y en contra con datos y cierra con certeza graduada.

es: Debatir una afirmación: presentar una postura razonada, responder a objeciones con evidencia y reconocer con tacto el límite de la propia prueba.

prompt.es: Escribe tu postura en el debate: dos respuestas con evidencia y un límite reconocido.

answer.text: In my view, schools should start later in the morning. Some people say that students will just go to bed later. That is a fair point, but given that teenagers need more sleep, a later start may well help them. A school survey found that students who slept more got better grades. Another objection is that parents start work early. I see it differently: a later start is a small change, and the benefits are clear. However, I accept that my evidence has limits, because the survey only covered one school. I doubt that one rule fits everyone.
accepted: In my view, schools should start later in the morning. Some people say that students will just go to bed later. That is a fair point, but given that teenagers need more sleep, a later start may well help them. A school survey found that students who slept more got better grades. Another objection is that parents start work early. I see it differently: a later start is a small change, and the benefits are clear. However, I accept that my evidence has limits, because the survey only covered one school. I doubt that one rule fits everyone.

I take the view that schools should start later. Some people say that parents start work early. Another objection is that students will go to bed later. That may be true for some, but the benefits seem clear to me. I admit that my evidence is limited, because it comes from only one school, and I doubt that one rule fits everyone.
